name: Sustained beam
description: A horizontal magenta beam fired leftward from a floating emitter on the right. Motes converge for a second and a violet ball tightens at the muzzle; the beam snaps out to full length in 0.2 s and holds for 2.3 s as a white core inside a striped magenta sheath, sitting in a hard-tiered violet body slab flanked by flat lilac and dark-violet flame licks that re-hash ten times a second, with a tall lens flare and a ring of rays at the muzzle. The core retracts from the far end over half a second, a run of white sparkles races down the former beam line, and a yellow-green residue scatters along it and drifts out over the last second.
